children: Morgans analyst Nathan Lead stays cautious on ANZ ahead of its annual result announcement next month. With an unchanged trim rating, Lead acknowledges that ANZ trades on lower multiples than its domestic banking peers, but warns of complexities from its institutional exposure, international activities, and funding reliance on wholesale and term deposits. Lead modestly lifts his EPS forecasts through fiscal 2028 but tells clients in a note that he remains skeptical that ANZ can deliver on CEO Nuno Matos's revenue targets. Morgans forecasts a fiscal 2026 cash profit of 7.5 billion Australian dollars. Target price rises 2.7% to A$34.44. Shares are at A$39.90 ahead of the open.  (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
